crusadecraft.name.invalid: This name won't do: 1 to %s characters, no formatting codes.
crusadecraft.name.colony.none: Stand in one of your colonies to rename it.
crusadecraft.name.realm.title: New name of the realm
crusadecraft.name.realm.tip: Rename the realm: the new name appears everywhere, on the mod's map as on Dynmap.
crusadecraft.name.city.title: New name of the city
crusadecraft.name.city.tip: Rename the city: the MineColonies colony is renamed, and the map follows.
crusadecraft.codex.carte_fantasy.p0: On Dynmap, each realm has its $(l)name written large$() at the heart of its lands, and each city its icon: a $(l)golden seal$() for a capital, a ringed dot for a city, a dot for a village, a tower for a stronghold. City names stay shown; those of villages and small places appear as you zoom in.$(br2)Whatever you place or paint (boundary staff, map editor) appears at the next refresh.
crusadecraft.codex.carte_fantasy.p1: $(l)Renaming$(): the $(l)✎$() button of the royal menu for your realm, the one in the Cities screen for a city (the MineColonies colony is renamed too), or the Places screen for everything else. By command: $(l)/crusade renommer royaume <name>$() and $(l)/crusade renommer ville <name>$() (inside the city).
